packageDesc: Mix of wildlife safari and mountain hiking

dayByDay.title: Tour of Kampala
dayByDay.description: Visit cultural sites and experience the local way of life in Uganda's vibrant capital.

dayByDay.title: Travel to Lake Mburo National Park
dayByDay.description: Journey south with a stop at the Equator for photos and exploration.

dayByDay.title: Morning Game Drive – Lake Mburo NP
dayByDay.description: Early morning game drive spotting zebras, impalas and buffalos, then travel to Kisoro in the south-west.

dayByDay.title: Hiking Mount Muhabura
dayByDay.description: Hike this iconic volcano (3,645m) with interaction with local communities along the trail.
dayByDay.footnote: Note: Mountain may be swapped for Rwenzori or Elgon depending on preference.

dayByDay.title: Return to Kampala
dayByDay.description: Scenic countryside views along the journey back with time for final shopping and reflection.

displayTitle: Quest for the Source of the Nile

dayByDay.title: Discover Islands on Lake Victoria
dayByDay.description: Boat out to the tranquil islands of Lake Victoria and interact with local fishing communities.

dayByDay.title: Shoebill Stork Birding Experience
dayByDay.description: Rare birdwatching in the papyrus swamps to spot the iconic Shoebill Stork, plus kayaking on the lake.

dayByDay.title: Visit the Source of the Nile
dayByDay.description: Visit the legendary source of the world's longest river in Jinja, with a boat cruise and sunset viewing.

dayByDay.title: Visit the Busoga Kingdom
dayByDay.description: Cultural visit to the ancient Busoga Kingdom with bicycle riding and community interaction.

dayByDay.title: White Water Rafting on the Nile
dayByDay.description: Thrilling grade 5 white water rafting on the Nile, the ultimate adrenaline finale before returning to Kampala.

dayByDay.title: Journey from Kampala to Ntungamo
dayByDay.description: Enjoy a scenic drive with stops at the Kayabwe Equator Line for photo opportunities and the vibrant Lukaya Roadside Market to experience local flavors and culture.

dayByDay.title: Visit Inspire Africa Coffee Park
dayByDay.description: Immerse yourself in Uganda's coffee heritage with a guided tour, followed by a unique canoe experience on Lake Nyabihoko.

dayByDay.title: Explore Nshenyi Cultural Village
dayByDay.description: Discover the richness of Ankole culture through authentic interactions, traditional practices, and the beauty of the surrounding landscape.

dayByDay.title: Hike to Karegyeya Rock
dayByDay.description: Take part in a refreshing hike with stunning views, and engage in meaningful conversations with local community members.

dayByDay.title: Discover the Sources of Kyafoora Hot Springs
dayByDay.description: Experience the natural wonder of the hot springs while connecting with the local community and learning about their traditions.

packageDesc: Algiers to the Heart of the Sahara

dayByDay.title: Arrival in Algiers
dayByDay.description: Arrival and hotel check-in. City tour including the iconic Casbah, Martyrs' Memorial, and the waterfront.

dayByDay.title: Algiers Cultural Day
dayByDay.description: Visit museums, historic neighbourhoods, and local markets. Experience Algerian culture and cuisine.

dayByDay.title: Algiers → Ghardaïa
dayByDay.description: Travel deep into the Sahara to Ghardaïa. Arrive, settle in, and enjoy an evening walk through the old town.

dayByDay.title: M'zab Valley Exploration
dayByDay.description: Discover the UNESCO-listed M'zab Valley, its remarkable traditional architecture, markets, and cultural heritage sites.

dayByDay.title: Return to Algiers
dayByDay.description: Free morning in Ghardaïa before returning to Algiers for departure.

displayTitle: Paths of Empires: Annaba to Constantine

dayByDay.title: Arrival in Annaba
dayByDay.description: Airport transfer and hotel check-in. Guided city tour of the region. Evening walk along the Corniche and waterfront.

dayByDay.title: Roman Heritage of Hippo Regius
dayByDay.description: Discover the Roman ruins of Hippo Regius, the Basilica of Saint Augustine, and Cap de Garde for panoramic Mediterranean views.

dayByDay.title: Annaba → Constantine
dayByDay.description: Travel to Constantine. City orientation tour and discovery of the historic old town and its cultural heritage.

dayByDay.title: The Bridges of Constantine
dayByDay.description: Explore the famous bridges including Sidi M'Cid and Mellah Slimane. Visit the Emir Abdelkader Mosque, old medina, and traditional markets.

dayByDay.title: Roman Sites & Panoramic Views
dayByDay.description: Cultural visit of Roman and historical sites, museums, and viewpoints overlooking Constantine's dramatic gorges. Free time for cafés and handicrafts.

dayByDay.title: Constantine → Annaba & Departure
dayByDay.description: Return to Annaba. Free time before airport transfer and departure.

note: Best to travel between December and March, flights from Cadjehoun Airport (Cotonou) are generally more affordable during this period.

dayByDay.title: Kingdom of Dahomey – Ancient Women Warriors
dayByDay.description: Visit the Amazons' historical sites, tour Africa's largest market, and receive a cultural orientation to this remarkable land.

dayByDay.title: Temple of Pythons – Ouidah
dayByDay.description: Visit the ancient slave market, the Queen of Ouidah's palace, Sacred Forest, Sacred Garden, and the Fondation Zinsou.

dayByDay.title: Vodun Dance Amphitheatre – Porte Nouvelle
dayByDay.description: International Museum of Vodoo, visit the Black River, learn about Spirit of Death traditions, and attend artisanal handicraft workshops.

dayByDay.title: Floating Livelihood – Ganvié / Abomey-Calavi
dayByDay.description: Canoe ride through the extraordinary floating stilt village of Ganvié, then explore the new city and enjoy a picnic with locals.

dayByDay.title: Day-to-Day Life of the Beninese People
dayByDay.description: Relaxing cultural activities and informal interactions with the warm and welcoming Beninese people.

country: Rwanda, Land of a Thousand Hills
displayTitle: Rwanda Discovery: 5 Nights / 6 Days of Culture, Nature & Adventure
packageDesc: Kigali, Musanze, Bigogwe, Lake Kivu and Nyanza heritage highlights

dayByDay.title: Kigali City Tour
dayByDay.description: Explore Kigali's highlights, including the Kigali Genocide Memorial, Nyandungu Eco Park in the afternoon, Inema Arts Center, and the vibrant car-free zones by night.

dayByDay.title: Mount Bisoke Adventure, Musanze
dayByDay.description: Hike Mount Bisoke (3,711m) and discover its stunning crater lake, with the option to visit the Dian Fossey Tomb and enjoy overnight camping at Red Rocks Rwanda.

dayByDay.title: Bigogwe Cultural Experience
dayByDay.description: Spend the day in Bigogwe with local herders, enjoying traditional cow milking, cultural dances, and authentic community interaction.

dayByDay.title: Lake Kivu Escape, Gisenyi
dayByDay.description: Relax by Lake Kivu with activities like boat rides and kayaking, then choose from evening shopping or lakeside nightlife.

dayByDay.title: Nyanza Heritage Tour
dayByDay.description: Visit the King's Palace Museum and see the iconic Inyambo cattle for a memorable close to Rwanda's royal heritage experience.
